episodes.title: Five Years Later
episodes.break_rationale: Scott Lang escapes the Quantum Realm and arrives at the Avengers compound with the quantum tunnel theory.
episodes.recap_text: Following the tragic confrontation with Thanos on the Garden, five grief-stricken years pass until Scott Lang miraculously emerges from a storage facility in San Francisco.
episodes.teaser_next: Tony Stark cracks the Mobius strip equation as the team prepares for the Time Heist.

episodes.title: The Time Heist
episodes.break_rationale: Natasha Romanoff sacrifices herself on Vormir for the Soul Stone while 2014 Nebula's neural network alerts past Thanos.
episodes.recap_text: The Avengers split into strike teams targeting 2012 New York, 2013 Asgard, and 2014 Morag to retrieve the six Infinity Stones.
episodes.teaser_next: A duplicate Nebula infiltrates the future while Hulk prepares to wield the Stark Nano Gauntlet.

episodes.title: Out of the Ashes
episodes.break_rationale: Hulk snaps everyone back, the compound is vaporized from orbit by Sanctuary II, and Cap stands alone against Thanos's horde before portals open.
episodes.recap_text: Bruce Banner snaps his fingers to restore the vanished half of the universe. Simultaneously, Thanos's warship breaches time and bombards upstate New York into rubble.
episodes.teaser_next: Golden portals open across the destroyed battlefield as the restored universe rallies for the final stand.

episodes.title: I Am Iron Man
episodes.break_rationale: The grand cosmic clash culminates in Tony Stark's final snap, the lakeside memorial, and Steve Rogers passing the shield.
episodes.recap_text: Every hero in the galaxy charges Thanos's forces. Tony Stark steals the stones and snaps his fingers, sacrificing his life to save existence.
episodes.teaser_next: Series finale concludes the epic superhero miniseries.
